/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import difflib, hashlib, json
old=Path('input.md').read_bytes()
new=Path('output.md').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest()==Path('checks/input.sha256').read_text().strip()
a=old.splitlines(keepends=True)
b=new.splitlines(keepends=True)
changes=[]
for tag,i,j,k,l in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None,a,b,autojunk=False).get_opcodes():
    if tag=='equal':
        continue
    assert tag=='insert' and all(line==b'\\n' for line in b[k:l]), (tag,i,j,k,l)
    changes.append({'kind':'insert_blank_line','before_input_line':i+1,'output_lines':[k+1,l],'count':l-k})
assert sum(c['count'] for c in changes)==2
Path('checks/changes.diff').write_text(''.join(difflib.unified_diff(old.decode().splitlines(True),new.decode().splitlines(True),fromfile='input.md',tofile='output.md')))
result={'status':'pass','input_unchanged':True,'original_bytes_preserved_in_order':True,'only_change':'Two inserted LF blank lines','insertions':changes,'input_sha256':hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest(),'output_sha256':hashlib.sha256(new).hexdigest()}
Path('checks/preservation.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\\n')
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
PY"
